CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 12

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

4. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 57

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

6. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

7. Solve for x: x + 3 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 12
   C. 11
   D. 14

8. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 6

9. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

11. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 11

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

13. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 25

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 1

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

16. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 16

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
